title: Puteanus: image of Christ alone gets relative latria, not absolute
source_text: XLVII. Juxta alios vero simpliciter dicendum est, Imagini Christi, cum adoratur sola, & seorsim ab exemplari, deberi quidem latriam, sed relativam, non autem absolutam. Haec est enim Puteani conclusio prima ad articulum tertium quaestionis vigesimae quintae modo citatae. Quando objectum materiale adorationis nostrae est sola imago Christi, & ratio adorandi solus Christus, per imaginem istam repraesentatus, adoratio haec non est proprie adoratio latriae, aut, ut alii loquuntur, non est adoratio latriae absoluta. Caeterum adoratur latria absoluta quod adoratur propter excellentiam increatam, quae reipsa est in re quae adoratur. Adoratur autem latria respectiva quod adoratur quidem propter excellentiam increatam, verum quae reipsa non est in re quae adoratur, sed ad quam res illa habitudinem aliquam & relationem habet.
pass_a_gloss: But according to others it is simply to be said that To the Image of Christ, when it is adored alone and apart from the exemplar, latria is indeed owed, but relative, not however absolute. For this is Puteanus's first conclusion to the third article of question twenty-five just cited. When the material object of our adoration is the image of Christ alone, and the reason of adoring is Christ alone, represented through that image, this adoration is not properly an adoration of latria, or, as others speak, is not an absolute adoration of latria. But that is adored with absolute latria which is adored on account of uncreated excellence which is really in the thing that is adored. But that is adored with respective latria which is indeed adored on account of uncreated excellence, yet which is not really in the thing that is adored, but toward which that thing has some habitude and relation.
pass_b_english: Puteanus's line: when Christ's image alone is the material object, the latria owed is relative, not absolute.
Absolute latria tracks uncreated excellence in the thing; respective latria tracks excellence only by relation.
